page.overview:
Who is Bail Antilles's wife?

A female individual was the wife of Bail Antilles, a Human male who represented the planet Alderaan in the Senate of the Galactic Republic. The two were married by 34 BBY and living on the Republic's capital world Coruscant. Between 34 BBY and 32 BBY, Antilles and his wife attended a senatorial gathering in Galactic City's 500 Republica building, at the apartment suite of Naboo's Senator Palpatine. While there, Antilles's wife was engaged in conversation by Sei Taria, the Staff Aide of Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum.

The wife of Bail Antilles appeared in the 2012 novel Darth Plagueis, written by James Luceno..
